claims.evidence: No date-stamped or usage-log evidence in photos; age cannot be judged from static shots.
No video/audio of the machine running, no stitch sample shown; photos only show it static with tape measure draped over it.

risks.risk: Motor and belt may not run smoothly or may need servicing
risks.proof: Short video clip of machine running a seam at normal speed, showing smooth needle motion and consistent stitching
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-verified running condition, i.e. as if needing possible motor/belt service

risks.risk: Boxed 'EMEL CLUTCH MOTOR' may be a spare/new part not yet installed, or may be the one already fitted
risks.proof: Photo showing the motor connected under the table with wiring to the machine head, or a clear shot of the installed motor's label
risks.if_unproven: priced as if the boxed motor is a separate/spare item, not included upgrade

risks.risk: Wiring, foot pedal, and switch condition unknown (fire/safety risk, intermittent faults)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of pedal, plug, and wiring runs, plus a clip of pedal operation
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified electrical safety, worst case needing rewiring

risks.risk: Completeness of accessories (bobbins, needles, extra presser feet)
risks.proof: Photo of accessory tray/case contents opened, including the red flat case on the floor
risks.if_unproven: priced as base machine only, no extra accessories included

risks.proof: Photo from a low angle showing legs, joints, and a short clip of the table being pushed to check wobble
risks.if_unproven: priced as if stand has unknown wear, worst case needing reinforcement or replacement

risks.risk: Prior repair or service history, hidden mechanical wear
risks.proof: Any service receipts or seller statement backed by maintenance log photo
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown service history, worst case near-due for servicing

proof_requests: Video of the machine sewing a straight seam and a curve, with audio of motor sound
Photo of the clutch motor's installation point under the table, wiring intact
Open view of the red case and any accessory tray showing bobbins/needles/feet
Close-up of foot pedal and power cord condition
Low-angle photo or clip testing table stability
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as an Emel industrial sewing machine, so it can be priced at worst case given unverified running condition, unknown motor installation, and unverified accessory completeness.
